**Session summary: brain**

## Goal
Cold-boot status read of brain after the v1.0.0 cut → triage the untracked `PLAN-adapters-v3.md`
against the master plan / epic / code / memory → discover and repair three rotted planning artifacts
→ make #313 the single source of truth → create the missing milestone tickets → clean the working
tree. Session ended with the tree at 0 untracked entries, 2 PRs awaiting the owner's approval
signature, and 4 new issues.

## Instructions (owner preferences, durable)
- **Verify before asserting.** The owner explicitly challenged a verdict mid-session ("¿has macheado
  el ticket 313, el master plan, el código de main, la memoria y el PLAN?"). The answer was no — the
  first pass used file-EXISTENCE greps as a proxy for completeness and produced three false "done"
  calls. Cross-check every source named, and say plainly which claims are verified vs carried
  forward unverified.
- **Show artifacts before publishing them.** The owner asked to see the full #313 body text before
  it was written. Default to proposing outward-facing text, not applying it.
- **Terminology is load-bearing.** The owner corrected "gentle-ai is a harness" → it is an
  **SDD_ENGINE**. Getting the axis wrong invalidated a whole comparison.
- Never apply `status:approved` — that is the owner's signature (#124). Agent creates issues and PRs;
  the owner approves.
- Never add AI attribution / Co-Authored-By to commits.

## Discoveries (reusable)
- **File existence ≠ feature completeness.** `plain.mjs` exists, is tracked, has tests — and is 29
  lines exporting only `init`. All four backends export only `init`; `VALID_OPS = ['init']`
  (`brain/scripts/harness/cli.mjs:99`). Verify the export surface against the contract, not the
  filesystem.
- **Grepping for a flag name matches prose asserting its absence.** `rg -- '--apply' adopt.mjs`
  matched `"S1 has no --apply flag (that is a future slice)"` (adopt.mjs:25). Read the file.
- **When a fresh finding contradicts the audit scorecard, the scorecard wins until explained.** The
  first-pass conclusion "harness credibility gap CLOSED" contradicted premise #2's 40% and that
  contradiction went unnoticed.
- **ADR-0019 leaves the door open for M8.** It rejected *"treat the single-`init`-op surface as the
  normative ceiling"* — "the four surfaces are the invariant, the op count is just today's state."
  Only *per-backend scaffold/verify/archive* is forbidden. So M8 may be a **narrow amendment**, not
  the "conscious supersede" the plan of record assumes. Defensible line: route who PRODUCES an
  artifact per stage, keep who VERIFIES it neutral.
- **`openspec/changes/issue-267/` was NOT a duplicate.** 930 lines vs the tracked
  `issue-267-context-synthesizer/` 142 lines, and a *different* proposal (changeset-driven
  `brain:context:compile` vs targeted-scan + core floor). The feature shipped via the tracked dir in
  PR #309. #314's premise is wrong, and there is a second instance (#260) it does not mention.
- **Three planning artifacts had all rotted against the same repo**: #313's body still described the
  superseded hybrid cut with no M8; both `docs/inbox/` docs were frozen at `c85386a` (2026-07-24
  14:19) — *before* the 22:01 cut — and never re-synced; `PLAN-adapters-v3.md` was ~65% already
  implemented. Root cause: four artifacts, no declared precedence, no verified-against stamp.
- **`docs/inbox/**` is ungoverned**: absent from the `consolidation-protocol.md` §3 zone map AND from
  `governance.ignoreList`, so capture prose rots silently and still burns the 400-line diff budget.
  A 548-line capture doc could not be committed without `size:exception`. → #327.
- **`issue-link` requires BOTH** a `Closes/Fixes/Resolves #N` in the PR body (for PRs to `main`;
  slice PRs also accept `Part of #N`) AND that issue carrying `status:approved`
  (`.github/workflows/governance.yml:44-95`). Approving the issue does NOT re-trigger the workflow —
  `gh run rerun <id> --failed`.
- `gh issue edit --add-label` silently fails on this repo (projects-classic). Use
  `gh api --method POST repos/OWNER/REPO/issues/N/labels -f "labels[]=<label>"`. DELETE works with
  the label in the path.
- brain has **no** `.github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/` — the global `issue-creation` skill targets a different
  repo. Convention here is plain issues, `type(scope): description` titles, `type:*` labels.
- `.gitlab-ci.yml` is a bare `include:` and `brain/scripts/ci/gitlab-governance.yml` carries all 9
  jobs — exactly the include-based approach PLAN-v3 A2 recommended, already shipped.

## Accomplished
- ✅ **#313 body rewritten and published** (44 → ~185 lines). Corrects the cut point (M1 partial,
  G3+G4 only), the sequence (`#210 → M2 → M3 → M4 → M5 → M8 → M9 → M6 → M7`), adds M8 and M9, marks
  G1/G2 deferred, declares itself the source of truth. Backup of the original in the session
  scratchpad.
- ✅ **#321 + PR #322** — snapshot stamps on both `docs/inbox/` planning docs; MASTER-PLAN M1 row and
  1.1 sequence patched. 33 lines. 7 checks green, `issue-link` awaiting approval.
- ✅ **#323 — M8** per-stage SDD engine routing, with the ADR amendment-vs-supersede question stated.
- ✅ **#324 — M9** `brain:metrics`, detection-only, no dependencies.
- ✅ **#325 + PR #326** — `.gitignore` `.memory/chunks/` (6.7 MB); persist `brain-drafts/`
  (adr-0023 + worktree convention); remove `design-docs/` (byte-identical dupes) and the two
  superseded `openspec/changes/` dirs. 145 lines, inside budget, no `size:exception`. 7 green.
- ✅ **#327** — govern `docs/inbox/**`: ignoreList entry (agent-writable) + zone-map row (human
  signature, `brain/**`) + a `verified-against` stamp convention.
- ✅ `PLAN-adapters-v3.md` stamped, archived to
  `~/.claude/projects/-home-gandalf-IA-brain/superseded-2026-07-25/PLAN-adapters-v3.STAMPED.md`,
  removed from the repo. Same dir holds the two removed change dirs.
- ✅ Working tree: **0 untracked entries**.
- 🔲 Both PRs blocked on `issue-link` — needs the owner's `status:approved` on #321 and #325.

## Next Steps
1. Approve #321 and #325 (REST, not `gh issue edit`), `gh run rerun --failed`, merge #322 and #326.
2. Approve #323 (M8) and #324 (M9) when ready to start them.
3. **#210 is the real first item of 1.1** — still open, still unapproved.
4. Re-scope or close **#314**: its "duplicate dir" premise is wrong and both instances are already
   removed by #326.
5. Consider closing **#305** — its code shipped in 1.0 but the issue is still open.
6. M0 remainder: close #217 / #222.

## Relevant Files
- `docs/inbox/MASTER-PLAN-1.0.md` — stamped snapshot; M1 row + 1.1 sequence patched (branch `docs/issue-321-*`)
- `docs/inbox/brain-v2-epic-plan.md` — stamped snapshot (Spanish banner, matching the file's language)
- `.gitignore` — `.memory/chunks/` entry (branch `chore/issue-325-*`)
- `brain-drafts/adr-0023-sdd-role-port.md` — M5 draft #312 must ratify; MASTER-PLAN points at it by path
- `brain/scripts/harness/cli.mjs:99` — `VALID_OPS = ['init']`, the premise-#2 40% in one line
- `brain/scripts/harness/backends/` — mixes two axes (claude/antigravity = AGENT_PLATFORM,
  gentle-ai/plain = SDD_ENGINE); naming debt flagged as an M2 candidate in #313
- `brain/project/decisions/adr-0019-harness-port.md` — the amendment-vs-supersede evidence for #323
- `brain/scripts/adopt.mjs:25` — proves `--apply` is unbuilt
- `.github/workflows/governance.yml:44-95` — the `issue-link` gate's exact requirements
